description: This file defines a TemplateProcessor class for handling template variable processing in MCP commands, including methods for processing commands, environment variables, and creating template variables based on configuration and port.

classes.name: TemplateProcessor
classes.description: Handles template variable processing for MCP commands, including processing commands, environment variables, and creating template variables.

methods.name: NewTemplateProcessor
methods.description: Creates a new instance of TemplateProcessor with specified project directory and verbosity.

methods.name: ProcessCommand
methods.description: Replaces template variables in a command string with actual values.

methods.name: ProcessCommands
methods.description: Processes multiple command strings, replacing template variables in each.

methods.name: CreateTemplateVars
methods.description: Generates template variables based on configuration and port.

methods.name: ProcessEnvironment
methods.description: Processes environment variable map, replacing template variables in each value.
